questions.knowledgeNote: Constant second difference 2: T_r = r^2; sum is the square-pyramid formula.
questions.question: Q1(a). Find the nth term and the sum of the first n terms of 1+4+9+16+...
questions.solution: T_r = r^2. S_n = 1^2+2^2+...+n^2 = n(n+1)(2n+1)/6 (standard formula; matches the printed key).
questions.source: Sukunda Basic Mathematics Grade XI, Ch.8 Ex 8.3 Q1(a); book p229 = PDF p256 (vision read)

questions.knowledgeNote: r(r+2) = r^2+2r: add the square-sum and twice the natural-sum.
questions.question: Q1(b). Find the nth term and the sum of the first n terms of 1.3+2.4+3.5+...
questions.source: Sukunda Basic Mathematics Grade XI, Ch.8 Ex 8.3 Q1(b); book p229 = PDF p256 (vision read)

questions.knowledgeNote: r(r+1) = r^2+r: S_n = square-sum + natural-sum = n(n+1)(n+2)/3.
questions.question: Q1(c). Find the nth term and the sum of the first n terms of 2+6+12+20+...

questions.knowledgeNote: (2r-1)(2r+1) = 4r^2-1: four times the square-sum minus n.

questions.knowledgeNote: Each bracket is the sum of the first r odd numbers = r^2: reduces to Q1(a).
questions.question: Q1(e). Find the nth term and the sum of the first n terms of 1+(1+3)+(1+3+5)+...
questions.solution: The rth bracket is 1+3+...+(2r-1) = r^2, so T_r = r^2. S_n = n(n+1)(2n+1)/6 (matches the printed key).
questions.source: Sukunda Basic Mathematics Grade XI, Ch.8 Ex 8.3 Q1(e); book p229 = PDF p256 (vision read)

questions.question: Q1(f). Find the nth term and the sum of the first n terms of 3+7+13+21+31+...
questions.solution: First differences 4, 6, 8, 10, ... (second difference 2), so T_r = r^2+r+1 (T_1 = 3, T_2 = 7, T_3 = 13 ✓). S_n = n(n+1)(2n+1)/6+n(n+1)/2+n = n(2n^2+6n+10)/6 = n(n^2+3n+5)/3 (matches the printed key).
questions.source: Sukunda Basic Mathematics Grade XI, Ch.8 Ex 8.3 Q1(f); book p229 = PDF p256 (vision read)

questions.knowledgeNote: T_r = r(n-r+1) = (n+1)r-r^2: symmetric in r and (n-r+1), sum doubles cleanly.
questions.question: Q2. Find the general term and the sum of first n terms: 1.n+2.(n-1)+3.(n-2)+...
questions.solution: T_r = r(n-r+1) = (n+1)r-r^2 (matches the key's general term). S_n = (n+1)·n(n+1)/2-n(n+1)(2n+1)/6 = n(n+1)[(n+1)/2-(2n+1)/6] = n(n+1)(n+2)/6 (matches the printed key).
questions.source: Sukunda Basic Mathematics Grade XI, Ch.8 Ex 8.3 Q2; book p229-230 = PDF pp256-257 (vision read)

questions.knowledgeNote: Odd squares: 4 times square-sum, minus 4 times natural-sum, plus n.

questions.knowledgeNote: Odd cubes: expand (2r-1)^3 and collect — the linear terms cancel to leave n^2(2n^2-1).
questions.question: Q3(b). Sum to n terms: 1^3+3^3+5^3+...
questions.solution: T_r = (2r-1)^3 = 8r^3-12r^2+6r-1. S_n = 8[n(n+1)/2]^2-12·n(n+1)(2n+1)/6+6·n(n+1)/2-n = n^2(2n^2-1) after simplification (matches the printed key; check n = 1: 1 ✓; n = 2: 1+27 = 28 = 4·7 ✓).
questions.source: Sukunda Basic Mathematics Grade XI, Ch.8 Ex 8.3 Q3(b); book p230 = PDF p257 (vision read)

questions.knowledgeNote: r^2(2r-1) = 2r^3-r^2: twice the cube-sum minus the square-sum.

questions.knowledgeNote: Geometric part plus arithmetic part: x(x^n-1)/(x-1) + a·n(n+1)/2.
questions.question: Q4(a). Sum to n terms: (x+a)+(x^2+2a)+(x^3+3a)+...
questions.solution: T_r = x^r+ra. S_n = (x+x^2+...+x^n)+a(1+2+...+n) = x(x^n-1)/(x-1)+an(n+1)/2 (matches the printed key).
